beats.text: Every square kilometre of Bangladesh holds 1,333 people. In Australia, it is 4.
Rwanda has 600 people per square kilometre. That is 24 times Brazil, which has 25.
At the other extreme, Greenland is the lowest, with its value at 0.
The Netherlands has 534. This is one of the highest values in Europe.
India and China, the giants, aren't the most crowded. India has 488. China, just 150.
The emptiest big countries? Mongolia has 2, Australia has 4, Canada has 5, and Russia has 9.
Population density is midyear population divided by land area in square kilometers.
